newsitem.title: UK: Serco/Laing chosen for UK military college.
newsitem.headline: Serco/Laing chosen for UK military college.

text.p: A consortium of Serco Group Plc and John Laing Plc is the Ministry of Defence's preferred bidder to establish a new Joint Services Command and Staff College, defence minister Nicholas Soames said on Tuesday.
The consortium is known as Defence Management.

"Subject to successful detailed negotiations, Defence Management would be awarded a contract for the provision of the accommodation, facilities management and academic support required for the new college, in June 1997," Soames said in a parliamentary written answer.
He gave no indication of the likely value of the contract.
